data.one_liner: Dio interceptor that records HTTP request metrics in Firebase Performance.
data.what_it_does: The package provides a Dio interceptor which creates a Firebase Performance HttpMetric for each request and reports timing data. It stores the metric in the request's extra field and finishes it when the response arrives.
use_when: You already use Dio for network calls and want automatic performance monitoring with Firebase.
You need minimal code to add Firebase Performance metrics to existing Dio requests.
avoid_when: You are not using Firebase Performance in your project.
You use a different HTTP client (e.g., http package) and cannot add a Dio interceptor.
strengths: Zero‑boilerplate integration with existing Dio instances
Keeps metric lifecycle tied to Dio request lifecycle
weaknesses: Works only with Dio, not other HTTP clients
Relies on firebase_performance plugin setup separately
data.setup_notes: Ensure firebase_performance is initialized in your app (e.g., call Firebase.initializeApp and enable Performance collection). Then add the interceptor to your Dio instance.
